title: Rory and the Moon-Blossom Glade
verses:
The moon had just risen above the high trees,
When Nia swooped down through the cool evening air.
A low humming song floated in on the breeze,
And Rory walked closer to see what was there.

Bright blossoms of silver uncurled on the ground,
As Ricky ran forward to peek at the glow.
Soft lights made of crystal were scattered around,
While Tilly swayed slowly and rocked to and fro.

Then Psittaco chirped as he tucked in his wing,
And rested his head on a cushion of moss.
Above them the night started softly to sing,
Where shadows of vines drifted gently across.

Then Benny stretched out near the shimmering stream,
And Rory curled up with a sigh in the deep.
The meadow was wrapped in a mystical dream,
As all of the world drifted off into sleep.

The stars sparkled down through the canopy high,
While Nia tucked neatly beneath a soft crest.
A nightingale sang a slow lullaby,
To settle the friends in their quiet and rest.

Now Rory closed eyes as the blossoms dimmed low,
Surrounded by warmth and the peace of the glade.
With breathing so gentle and steady and slow,
He slept till the morning when starlight would fade.
